name: anotes
author: Kyle Arrington
description: Apple Notes on the Omarchy desktop. Reads, searches and edits the notes syncing to your iPhone, over an applenotes daemon running on a Mac on your tailnet.

barWidget.description: Browse, search and edit Apple Notes from the bar.

schema.label: Daemon URL
schema.description: The applenotes daemon on your Mac, for example http://100.96.91.16:8437. Leave blank to read ~/.config/applenotes/url.

schema.label: Token
schema.description: Bearer token. Leave blank to read ~/.config/applenotes/token.
